title: Conditions of Entry to the Ridgecrest RxSecure Plans
content:
A member may be enrolled in a Ridgecrest RxSecure stand-alone Medicare Part D prescription drug plan only where every condition of entry written for the plan elected is met. Four conditions are written into all six plans; the two highest plans add further conditions of their own.

| Plan | Entitled to Part A or enrolled in Part B | Permanent residence in the plan region | Not enrolled in a Medicare Advantage plan that includes Part D | Minimum age | Continuous coverage in the prior year | Mail-order enrollment |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Ridgecrest RxSecure Basic (PDP) | required | required | required | 65 | not required | not required |
| Ridgecrest RxSecure Value (PDP) | required | required | required | 65 | not required | not required |
| Ridgecrest RxSecure Select (PDP) | required | required | required | 65 | not required | not required |
| Ridgecrest RxSecure Plus (PDP) | required | required | required | 65 | not required | not required |
| Ridgecrest RxSecure Complete (PDP) | required | required | required | 65 | required | not required |
| Ridgecrest RxSecure Premier (PDP) | required | required | required | 65 | required | required |

Put as conditions in turn: on any of the six plans the member must be entitled to Part A or enrolled in Part B, must have their permanent residence in the plan's region, must not be enrolled in a Medicare Advantage plan that includes Part D drug coverage, and must be at least 65 years of age. On Ridgecrest RxSecure Complete (PDP) the member must in addition have held continuous coverage in the prior year. On Ridgecrest RxSecure Premier (PDP) the member must have held that continuous prior-year coverage and must also be enrolled in the mail-order pharmacy benefit. The conditions of the higher plans are additional to the four common ones, never a substitute for them.
